summary: Master offshore safety management, risk assessment, and compliance. Learn ALARP, Bowtie analysis, and IMO standards in this 5-day practitioner course.
lede: Offshore regulatory compliance training covers risk assessment, operational safety controls, environmental management, and reporting for offshore operations. Designed for professionals responsible for asset and personnel safety, integrity, and compliance, it develops practical skills in Bowtie analysis, Permit to Work and SIMOPS planning, and SEMS gap analysis.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is built for professionals responsible for the safety, integrity, and compliance of offshore assets and personnel.
modules: Offshore Safety Foundations and Regulatory Frameworks
Advanced Risk Assessment and ALARP Methodology
Operational Safety and Permit to Work Systems
Technical Integrity and Asset Safety Management
Human Factors and Safety Culture Maturity
Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in offshore operations, HSE, or engineering. Familiarity with basic risk assessment concepts and general maritime or oil and gas terminology is recommended. No specific software is required, though a laptop is necessary for digital exercises.
